import numpy as np
import xarray as xr

nz = 11
ds = xr.Dataset(
    data_vars={
        "y": ("z", np.random.rand(nz)),
        "lev": ("z", np.arange(nz) * 10),
        # ^ We want this to be a dimension coordinate
    },
)
print(f"ds\n{ds}")
print(f"\nds, 'lev' -> dim coord\n{ds.swap_dims(z='lev')}")

ds2 = (
    ds.swap_dims(z="lev")
    .rename_dims(lev="z")
    .reset_index("lev")
    .reset_coords()
)
print(f"\nds2\n{ds2}")
# ^ This Dataset appears same as the original

print(f"\nds2, 'lev' -> dim coord\n{ds2.swap_dims(z='lev')}")
# ^ Produces a Dataset with dimension coordinate 'lev'
print(f"\nds2 after .swap_dims() applied\n{ds2}")
# ^ `ds2['lev']` now has dimension 'lev' although otherwise same

lev_before = ds2["lev"].dims
ds2.swap_dims(z="lev")
lev_after = ds2["lev"].dims
print(f"\nBEFORE swap_dims: ds2['lev'].dims = {lev_before}")
print(f"AFTER  swap_dims: ds2['lev'].dims = {lev_after}")
assert lev_before == ("z",), f"expected ('z',), got {lev_before}"
assert lev_after == ("z",), f"BUG: ds2 was mutated, dims now {lev_after}"
print("OK: no mutation")

import traceback
import numpy as np
import xarray as xr
from xarray.core import variable

nz = 11
ds = xr.Dataset(
    data_vars={
        "y": ("z", np.random.rand(nz)),
        "lev": ("z", np.arange(nz) * 10),
    },
)
ds2 = (
    ds.swap_dims(z="lev")
    .rename_dims(lev="z")
    .reset_index("lev")
    .reset_coords()
)

target = ds2.variables["lev"]
target_id = id(target)
print("target lev variable:", target_id, "dims:", target.dims, type(target))

orig_setter = type(variable.Variable).dims.setter.__func__ if False else None

# wrap the dims property setter on Variable
_dims_prop = variable.Variable.dims
import xarray.core.variable as V

def dims_setter(self, value):
    if id(self) == target_id:
        print("\n>>> MUTATION of target variable! setting dims to", value)
        traceback.print_stack()
    _orig_fset(self, value)

# get the raw fset of the property
_orig_fset = type(_dims_prop).fset.__get__(None, object) if False else _dims_prop.fset

variable.Variable.dims = property(_dims_prop.fget, dims_setter)

try:
    result = ds2.swap_dims(z="lev")
finally:
    variable.Variable.dims = _dims_prop

print("\nafter swap_dims: target dims:", target.dims)
print("result lev dims:", result.variables["lev"].dims)
print("same object in result?", result.variables["lev"] is target)
